senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טִלְטֵל)to move, carry off; to receive, take.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:1">B. Mets. I, 1</cite> <he>זה נוֹטֵל וכ׳</he> the one (of the claimants) gets three shares &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:4:4">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>ומה שכר נָטְלוּ על כך</he> what reward did they get for it?—Sifra Sh’mini, beg. <he>מסיני נטלו להם</he> they got (their punishment) from Sinai.
<cite ref="Shabbat 151b:5">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite> <he>טוֹל מה וכ׳</he> take away what thou hast put into me.

<cite ref="Arakhin 16b">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 15b:10">B. Bath. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>טול קיסם מבין עיניך</he> (Ag. Hatt. <he>שיניך</he>) remove the chip from between thy eyes (teeth); <he>טול קורה וכ׳</he> remove the beam from &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 6:1">Gitt. VI, 1</cite> <he>אף האומרת טול לי גטי</he> even if she says, get me my letter of divorce (instead of ‘receive for me’).
<cite ref="Gittin 78a:14">Ib. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>טְלִי גיטיך וכ׳</he> take up thy letter of divorce from the ground.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite>, end <he>נָטַלְתִּי עיני</he> I lifted up my eyes.

Ber. II, 8 לא כל הרוצה לִיטּוֹל לו את השם יִטּוֹל Y. ed., not every one who desires to assume a name, may assume it, i.e. not every one has a right to consider himself superior to the masses (v. יוֹהֲרָא); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. נָטוּל; f. נְטוּלָה removed.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 11:12">Ned. XI, 12</cite> (if a woman says) <he>נ׳ אני מן היהודים</he> I will be removed from (keep no company with) Jews; <he>יפר … ותהא נ׳ וכ׳</he> the husband may forbid the vow as far as it concerns himself, and (for the rest) let her be isolated &c.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21b:5">Snh. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>נְטוּלֵי טחול</he> persons who had their milt cut out (to make them fast runners).—V. <cite ref="N00545"><he>נְטוּלָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (sub. מים) to pour water over one’s hands for purification; נ׳ לידים, (ellipt.) נ׳ ידים, or only נ׳ to wash the hands before and after meals, before prayer &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yadayim 1:1">Tosef. Yad. I, 1</cite> <he>מי רביעית נוֹטְלִין לידים וכ׳</he> (Var. ed. Zuck., a. Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 1:1">ib. I, 1</cite> <he>נותנין</he>) a quantity of one fourth of a Log of water may be used for pouring over the hands of one person &c. Ib. 13 <he>הנוֹטֵל לידים הנוטל מתכוין והנותן וכ׳</he> if a person had his hands washed, himself having the intention (of purification), while he who poured it had not. Ib. 2; Mish. ib. II, 3 <he>נ׳ את הראשונים</he> if he began to use the water for washing before the meal (v. <cite ref="M01199"><he>מַיִם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 107a:2">Ḥull. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>נוטלין ממנו לידים</he> you may use it for washing the hands; Tosef. l. c. 6.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 8:2">Ber. VIII, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 51a:14">Ib. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תִּטּוֹל ידיך ממי וכ׳</he> have not water poured over thy hands by one who has not washed his hands &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 105a:15">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>נוטלין … בכלי</he> you must wash over a vessel (receiving the water); <he>ע״ג קרקע</he> on the floor; a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:1">Sabb. XVII, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 122b:9">122ᵇ</cite>) <he>כל הכלים נִיטְּלִין בשבת</he> all vessels (implements, utensils &c.) may be handled on the Sabbath. Ib. 43ᵃ, a. e. <he>אין כלי נ׳ אלא לדבר הנ׳ בשבת</he> a utensil must not be handled on the Sabbath except for the protection of a thing which may be used on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:9">Par. V, 9</cite> <he>והן יכולות להִנָּטֵל וכ׳</he> and they can be handled simultaneously; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:2">2</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00076"><he>כָּבֵר</he> III</cite>. Ohol. II, 3 <he>כדי שיִנָּטֵל מן כ׳</he> as much of it as, if cut out from the skull of a living being, would cause death; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Yadayim 2:7">Tosef. Yad. II, 7</cite> <he>לא נִטְּלוּ מן הכלי</he> the water was not poured directly from the vessel; <he>לא ניטלו מן הרביעית</he> not poured from a vessel containing one fourth of a Log; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to throw; to put; to hang on, attach.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:9">Gitt. V, 9</cite> <he>משתַּטִּיל המים</he> from the time she pours water on the flour.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:2">Yoma III, 2</cite> <he>המַטִּיל מים</he> who urinates.
<cite ref="Menachot 40b">Men. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ לבעלת וכ׳</he> if he attached the fringe (<cite ref="V00547"><he>תְּכֵלֶת</he></cite>) to a three-cornered garment.
<cite ref="Shabbat 42b:7">Sabb. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>להַטִּיל ביצתה</he> to lay her eggs; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (of plants) to assume the shape of, to develop.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:2">Maasr. I, 2</cite> <he>משיַטִּילוּ שאור</he>, v. <cite ref="U00016"><he>שְׂאוֹר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:2">ib.</cite> <he>משיטילו גידין</he>, v. <cite ref="C00626"><he>גִּיד</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be thrown; to lie. Part. מוּטָּל, f. מוּטֶּלֶת; pl. מוּטָּלִים, מוּטָּלִין; מוּטָּלוֹת

units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 82b:5">Kidd. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ברעב</he> lies prostrated from starvation.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:1">Ber. III, 1</cite> <he>מי שמתו מ׳ לפניו</he> he whose dead relative lies before him; <cite ref="Berakhot 18a:3">ib. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון שמ׳ עליו לקוברו כמ׳ וכ׳</he> since the duty of burying rests upon him, it is the same as if the body were lying before him.
<cite ref="Yevamot 37b">Yeb. 37ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ממו</he>‌‌<he>ן המ׳ בספק</he>, v. <cite ref="O01407"><he>סָפֵק</he></cite>; a. fr.—

senses.gloss: מוּטֶּלֶת a garment provided with show-fringes. Men. l. c. הטיל למ׳ if he attached additional fringes to a garment provided &c.; a. fr.
